name: winfs-mcp
description: Secure Windows filesystem, git, exec and process-control MCP server with allowed-roots enforcement, atomic writes, hard timeouts and an audit log.
long_description: winfs is a local MCP server for Windows 10/11. It exposes read/write/search/edit filesystem tools, read-only git, sandboxed command/python/pytest execution, persistent process sessions, SSRF-guarded fetch_url and more — all bounded by an allowed-roots whitelist, atomic temp+fsync+rename writes, hard-bounded timeouts, a shell blocklist and a redacting audit log. Configure the directories winfs may touch in the fields below; everything outside them is refused with EPERM_ROOT unless you explicitly opt into unrestricted mode.

allowedRoots.title: Allowed directories
allowedRoots.description: Directories winfs is permitted to read and write. Everything outside these roots is refused. You can add several.

execExtraPathDirs.title: Extra PATH directories (optional)
execExtraPathDirs.description: Absolute directories appended to the sandboxed PATH used by execute_command — for portable Git, MSYS2, chocolatey shims and other non-standard tool installs. Leave empty if unsure.

sshExePath.title: SSH executable (optional)
sshExePath.description: Path to ssh.exe for the ssh_exec tool. Leave empty to auto-detect (Git-bundled ssh → System32 OpenSSH → PATH).

powershellExePath.title: PowerShell executable (optional)
powershellExePath.description: Path to pwsh.exe or powershell.exe. Leave empty to auto-detect (pwsh 7+ on PATH, else Windows PowerShell 5.1).

pythonHome.title: Python home (optional)
pythonHome.description: Directory containing python.exe, used by run_python and run_pytest. Leave empty to use Python from PATH.

unrestrictedFilesystem.title: ⚠ Unrestricted filesystem mode — DANGEROUS
unrestrictedFilesystem.description: DANGER: disables the allowed-roots boundary, letting winfs touch ANY path your account can. Only enable if you fully understand the risk. Requires the confirm phrase below — leave OFF for normal use.

unrestrictedFilesystemConfirm.title: Unrestricted confirm phrase
unrestrictedFilesystemConfirm.description: Required ONLY if you turned on unrestricted mode above. Type exactly: I-UNDERSTAND-THE-RISK — otherwise the server will refuse to start.
